description: Every finite \(\Delta\subseteq\{p_n:n\in\mathbb N\}\) has a satisfying valuation which fails the whole theory. Thus no finite subset has exactly the same satisfying valuations as that theory.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.PropositionalCompactness.no_finite_equivalent_positive
  (Δ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula ℕ))
  (hΔ : ↑Δ ⊆ Lemmatheca.Entry.PropositionalCompactness.positiveTheory) :
  ∃ v,
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.SatisfiesContext v Δ ∧
      ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.ModelsTheory v
          Lemmatheca.Entry.PropositionalCompactness.positiveTheory
